ui.rolesLead: 不同职业对 AI Agent 的需求不同——这里为 5 种典型角色设计了对应的学习路径与重点。
ui.layersLead: 从写好提示词、动态管理上下文、目标自主循环、图工作流到 Harness 框架本身可编程。

ui.trackABlurb: Track A · CLI 能力者之路（8–10 周）
ui.trackADesc: Stage 0-2 共修基础 → 跳过 Stage 3/4/6/7 → 学 Stage 5 + 7.5 + 8，并同步 tracks/cli 专属文档。
ui.trackBBlurb: Track B · Agent 构建者之路（16–22 周）
ui.trackBDesc: 从 Stage 0 一路打到 Stage 8。Stage 3-4 是构建转折点，Stage 6 是记忆/RAG，Stage 7 是生产级 + 可观测性。

ui.budgetLead: 三种预算方案，从完全免费到全云端。推荐混合方案——本地练习 + 云端对比。
ui.budgetHint: 模型建议：Stage 1-2 用 gemma4:e4b；Stage 3+ 用 qwen2.5:3b；云端对比用 claude-haiku-4-5。

site.name: Agent Atlas
site.tagline: A Structured Guide to AI Agents
site.description: A curated learning map: 9 stages, 23 hands-on exercises, 240+ resources. From Prompt Engineering to Harness Engineering — zero to production-ready agents.

ui.footerNote: learning site based on open-source content ({license})
ui.footerLegal: MIT License · Maintained upstream by @WenyuChiou · Multilingual mirror
ui.tracksLead: After shared Stages 0–2, choose the CLI Power User track or the Agent Builder track.
ui.rolesLead: Different careers need different Agent skills — here are focused paths for five typical roles.
ui.layersLead: From writing prompts, managing context, autonomous loops, and graph workflows to programmable harnesses.
ui.stagesLead: Expand each stage for exercises, resources, and goals. Open any card to read the full guide.
ui.trackABlurb: Track A · CLI Power User (8–10 weeks)
ui.trackADesc: Shared Stages 0–2 → skip 3/4/6/7 → study Stage 5 + 7.5 + 8, plus the tracks/cli docs.
ui.trackBDesc: Go from Stage 0 through Stage 8. Stages 3–4 are the builder pivot; 6 is memory/RAG; 7 is production + observability.
ui.workflowLead: Every exercise folder follows the same structure. Work in this order for the best results.
ui.resourcesLead: When you need depth on a topic, use the guides under resources/.
ui.budgetLead: Three budget options from free to full cloud. Hybrid is recommended — local practice + cloud comparison.
ui.budgetHint: Model tip: Stages 1–2 → gemma4:e4b; Stage 3+ → qwen2.5:3b; cloud compare → claude-haiku-4-5.
